idea: NORMAL regime SHORT filter — block SHORT entries when regime is NORMAL
rationale: Data shows SHORT signals lose -.13 net in NORMAL (13 winners +$0.54, 13 losers -$1.67). But they WIN in EXTREME (+$4.35) and HIGH (+$3.40). Filtering SHORT in NORMAL could save ~$1.13/7d without affecting EXTREME/HIGH wins.
risk: low — only blocks SHORT in one regime, EXTREME/HIGH unaffected
impact_on_winners: Checked: SHORT winners in NORMAL are small (+$0.54 total) vs losses ($1.67). Net positive to filter.
reject_reason: I don't think this is a good idea, we'd be cutting tooo many trades out

idea: pullback-entry- SHORT: add MIN_RSI_ENTRY=30 filter (prevent shorting oversold)
rationale: pullback-entry- is the #1 STAR signal (32T/7d +$1.85) but has 11 losers. The rr_engine_resistance exits suggest we enter SHORT when price is at support. If RSI is oversold (<30), we are catching a falling knife in reverse. Session brain confirms: "shorting into oversold = catching falling knife"
expected_impact: Block 2-4 losing trades/7d, preserving the 20 winners
risk: low — only filters extreme oversold entries
impact_on_winners: Checked: no winning pullback-entry- SHORT had RSI < 30 at entry (all were in 35-55 range)

idea: pump-chain+ LONG: already killed, but consider pump-chain- in NORMAL — its avg_pnl_pct is -0.03% (breakeven). Filter SHORT in NORMAL only.

idea: Add trend_purity to VOL_PHASE_MULTS with EXTREME multiplier 0.3 (penalized, not blocked)

expected_impact: -$0.15/7d drag reduced, +2-3% WR for trend_purity+ in EXTREME
impact_on_winners: Checked: 4 winning trades in EXTREME (+$0.56) will still fire but with lower confidence. 4 losing trades (-$0.71) will be harder to fire.

idea: SHORT entry minimum support distance filter — block SHORT within 2% of nearest support
rationale: pullback-entry- SHORT has 16T/7d rr_engine_resistance exits avg -1.83%. Root cause: SHORT entries near support levels — price bounces from support, SHORT exits at resistance break. If we add MIN_SUPPORT_DISTANCE_PCT=2.0 to SHORT entry logic, we block entries where nearest support is within 2% of current price. This prevents the most common losing pattern.
expected_impact: Block 4-6 losing SHORT entries per 7d, preserving ~$0.70-1.00/7d
risk: medium — could reduce SHORT trade frequency
impact_on_winners: Need to verify: check if any winning SHORT entries had support within 2%
